'''Ropok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who started the company [[IsoTech]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, Ropok sympathized with the Confederacy. When the conflict came to an end with a Republic victory, Ropok set up a deal with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rel Harsol]], the Separatist captain of the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']]. Harsol had rescued the Separatist [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] expert [[Cratala]] from capture by the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the pair planned to work with Ropok to expand IsoTech into a black market cybernetics business. Harsol sent his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[IT-3PO]] to finalize the details of the plan, but when Cratala and Harsol reached [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] they intended to set up base on, their ship crashed onto the planet, where they became stranded and unable to communicate with the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Just prior to the ship's crash the captain attempted to send Ropok a [[message pod]], containing data on the coordinates of their crash, but the pod never reached [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] where Ropok worked. Without the cybernetics, Ropok found other means to keep IsoTech going, but he was eventually arrested by Imperials and imprisoned. He died while incarcerated and his children, a son named [[Reom]] and a daughter named [[Shira (Twi'lek)|Shira]], took over IsoTech, running it successfully, and eventually receiving the message pod which led to them hiring [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to find and save the crew of the ''Sa Nalaor''.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ropok was first mentioned in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'' an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.
